title: Session Host port, version 1
description: The one port that places an agent session: open then launch (the controller builds its command only after the slot exists), alive, front, retire. A session is started by its controller (the run supervisor) through open and launch; there is no single start operation. Adapters: terminal (Terminal Control), direct (screenless prepared command). Spec: docs/platform/session-host/spec.md.

key.description: Same key shape as terminal-control; for a run the attempt id, for a head session <persona>-<name>.

display.description: Terminal Control display fields; written to the screen only, never read back.

capability.description: The Terminal Control capability the driver lacks; present on an unsupported answer that came from the driver.

groupKey.description: Panes of one group share a tab.

beside.description: Open next to this existing placement; needs groupKey.

groupSize.description: How many panes the caller's batch opens in all, when it knows; sizes the batch's panes equally.

expect.description: The foreground process the launch is expected to become when it is not the command itself.

slot.description: The slot of the placement, for a diagnostic line: the one this call allocated, or the one a live key's pane already holds; absent only when that slot could not be read back.

rules: terminal only: Terminal Control allocate and nothing else; nothing is started in the slot. host direct answers unsupported / host-unsupported-here.
a key that already has a live placement answers that placement and allocates nothing.

terminal only: Terminal Control launch into the slot open allocated for the placement's key; the launched marker is durable before the answer, so the caller may let the process run on once it has the identity.
not-started: nothing was proven to run; the slot is kept and never launched into again.
host direct answers unsupported / host-unsupported-here: a screenless host has no slot to launch into.
unknown is never turned into gone.
answers whether the placement exists; who the session is and whether it is the live holder of a role stays Identity's.
terminal: the focus operation of Terminal Control.
direct and any screenless host: unsupported.
terminal: Terminal Control release; only a pane the port started is closed, never a tab.
retiring a placement already gone answers retired.
